topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I stumbled upon the manuscript tucked away in a drawer, hidden beneath layers of old receipts and forgotten mementos. It was a novel, and I, the central character, unknowingly living a life scripted by the very person who claims to love me. Each page, a detailed account of our days, our conversations, even moments I thought were private. It felt intrusive, yet strangely flattering. I pondered telling them, weighed down by the secret, unsure if my discovery would be seen as a breach of trust or a testament to the depth of their affection. The words lingered in my mind, a mix of intimacy and invasion that left me unsettled.
